It encodes bolivia's national identity in two regional-indicator letters, which is why it travels cleanly across keyboards and renders the same on iOS, Android, and the web.

In real-world usage 🇧🇴 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to flag where they are from, where they're going, or which team they're rooting for. That is why it travels especially well on World Cup threads, Olympics coverage, election night posts, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with bolivia energy in a single tap.
